description: This file is a React functional component for managing vector stores, including listing, viewing details, creating, editing, and deleting vector stores. It handles user interactions, fetches data from APIs, and displays UI elements such as modals and tables.

methods.name: fetchVectorStores
methods.description: Fetches the list of vector stores from the backend API.

methods.name: fetchCredentials
methods.description: Fetches the list of credentials from the backend API.

methods.name: handleRefreshClick
methods.description: Handles refresh button click to reload vector stores and credentials.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets state to open delete confirmation modal for a specific vector store.

methods.name: handleView
methods.description: Sets state to view details of a specific vector store.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Sets state to edit a specific vector store.

methods.name: handleCloseInfo
methods.description: Closes the vector store info view and refreshes the vector stores list.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms deletion of the selected vector store and calls API to delete it.

methods.name: handleCreateSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful creation of a new vector store, closing modal and refreshing list.
